newsitem.title: UK: UK FTSE hits new record in pre-market trading.
newsitem.headline: UK FTSE hits new record in pre-market trading.

text.p: The FTSE 100 index of UK blue chip companies hit a new intraday record in pre-market trading on Wednesday, the eve of the UK election, following a surge in U.S. stocks overnight.
The index rose 33.6 to 4,466.8 just before the 0730 GMT start of official trading.
The previous intraday record of 4,466.3 was hit on March 11, when the index also registered its closing peak of 4,444.3
